source_text: - A sound argument is re-checked at every premise, citation, and sub-claim the IR rests on. Extra text that does not meet a pattern, or that trips a look-alike, stays no_issue. The tree's stress is survives. - A thin or fallacious move fails open: a child hard flag, or a gap that is still possible_issue when the expander has nothing further. Stress is breaks (flagged or open). - The expander supplies real text or a real child IR. The checker does not invent claims, edges, or facts. Predicates and forbids are the ones already in the pilot file.
